Safia IMS — Privacy Policy

Last updated: 24 November 2026

Safia IMS is the internal production-management platform of the Safia bakery plants. It is used through the website production.safiacorporate.uz, a Telegram bot, and the Android app «Safia IMS» (uz.safiacorporate.ims), published on Google Play by «Safia Production». This policy explains what the platform collects, why, and who it is shared with.

Who can use it

Only Safia staff with an account issued by the company can sign in. There is no public sign-up, and the app does nothing without an account.

What we collect

  • Account and work data: your name, role, plant, shift and work cell, your login name, and the work records you enter — production figures, checklists, tasks, comments, concerns and the files you attach. Passwords are stored encrypted on our server.
  • Attendance data from the company's attendance system (Verifix): your name, position, work unit and clock-in / clock-out times. We do not read passport numbers, personal identification numbers or wages.
  • Photos: the camera is used only when you take a photo as proof of a checklist task, or attach a photo yourself. The app asks for camera permission the first time a page needs it.
  • Telegram: if you use the platform's Telegram bot, your Telegram user ID, name and username.
  • Technical data: the app version, device and browser type, IP address in server logs, and error reports the app sends when a screen fails, so we can fix it.
  • Notifications: the Android app asks our own server for new notifications about every 15 minutes. No third-party push service is used.

What we do not do

  • No advertising, and no data is sold.
  • No location, contacts, microphone or call data is collected by the app.
  • No tracking across other apps or websites.

Why we use it

To run the plants' daily work: planning and recording production, attendance and workload, checklists and their proofs, tasks and concerns, reports, and notifications to the people responsible. The data is used for Safia's internal operations only.

Who it is shared with

  • AI services — Google (Gemini) and Anthropic (Claude): checklist proof photos may be sent for an automatic check, and questions typed into the built-in assistant are answered by them. They process the data on our behalf.
  • Cloudflare: delivers the website over the internet and counts page visits without identifying you.
  • Telegram: carries the bot's messages if you use the bot.
  • Verifix: the company's attendance system, the source of attendance data.

Inside the company, what you see and what others see of you depends on roles set by the platform's administrators.

Where it is stored and how it is protected

Data is stored on Safia's own server and is always sent over encrypted connections (HTTPS). Access is limited by role, and actions are logged.

How long we keep it

Work records are kept as part of the company's operational records for as long as they are needed for that work. When someone leaves the company, their account is closed; their past work records stay part of the plant's history.

Your choices and rights

  • You can refuse the camera or notification permission in your phone's settings; only the features that need them stop working.
  • You can ask to see, correct or delete your personal data, or to close your account, by writing to the address below or asking your administrator.

Children

The platform is a workplace tool for adult staff and is not meant for children.

Changes

If this policy changes, the new version is published on this page with a new date.
